title: Canonical evidence and governed apply for generated artifacts

phases.objective: Publish one bounded read-only canonical report for PR generated-artifact evaluation and preserve mutation behind a registered manually dispatched exact-head tool.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: PR Generated Artifact Refresh through pull_request or exact-head workflow_dispatch after the trusted workflow definition is present on the default branch
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The read-only workflow reports exact-head pass, drift, or first failure without repository mutation, and the trusted workflow_run publisher updates the authoritative PR comment without Job-log reconstruction.
steps: Treat the workflow definition on the default branch as the active pull-request automation authority until this change is merged.
Resolve candidate SHA and target ref from the pull request or explicit workflow_dispatch inputs.
Checkout the exact candidate with read-only contents permission and without persisted credentials.
Verify that both local HEAD and the remote target ref equal the declared candidate SHA.
Generate and verify the bounded artifact set only inside the ephemeral runner workspace.
Return generated_artifact_drift_detected when reviewed generated files differ.
Upload canonical JSON and Markdown before enforcing the decision.
Validate the report against the current exact PR head before updating the authoritative comment.
assertions: The report contract is mad4b.pr-generated-artifact-refresh-summary.v1.
candidate_sha and source_head_sha equal the exact branch head.
The read-only workflow contains no repository write permission, git push, or persisted checkout credentials.
A workflow_dispatch run is accepted only for PR Generated Artifact Refresh and an exact current work-branch head.
The report declares secrets_included=false and bounded redacted diagnostics.
The publisher rejects stale, substituted, mismatched, closed-unmerged, or ambiguous PR identities.
The tests remain discoverable through the canonical repository test manifest.
Pre-merge behavior of a pull_request workflow is not used as proof of its replacement definition; operational proof begins after the trusted definition reaches the default branch.
Job logs remain diagnostic-only and never override the canonical report.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Governed Generated Artifact Refresh Dispatch from a trusted issue comment or explicit workflow_dispatch
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The trusted dispatcher publishes whether the exact-head writer was delegated before enforcing its decision, then the registered tool mutates only reviewed generated paths on a non-protected work branch, publishes the exact apply decision, and dispatches read-only verification on the resulting head.
steps: Run the issue-comment command from the default-branch workflow definition or invoke workflow_dispatch explicitly on main; never execute the dispatcher from a work-branch push.
Checkout trusted main publisher code with contents read and persisted credentials disabled.
Resolve the exact open same-repository PR, target_ref, expected_head_sha, and generated-artifact-refresh authorization label.
Upload mad4b.governed-generated-artifact-refresh-dispatch.v1 before enforcing the dispatch decision.
Publish the exact dispatcher decision directly from the trusted command workflow using pr_number, target_ref, and expected_head_sha.
Retain the trusted workflow_run publisher as a redundant recovery path rather than the sole publication authority.
Require target_ref, expected_head_sha, and APPLY_GENERATED_ARTIFACT_REFRESH confirmation for the delegated writer.
Reject main, Production, invalid branch names, malformed SHAs, stale PR heads, and ambiguous PR cardinality before generation.
Compare both local and remote heads to expected_head_sha before commit and again before push.
Generate and verify the bounded artifact set.
Reject every path outside the registered allowlist.
Commit and push by normal fast-forward only.
Upload mad4b.governed-generated-artifact-refresh.v1 before workflow enforcement.
Have the trusted default-branch publisher download the exact run-bound apply artifact.
Resolve the PR from target_ref and bind blocked reports to expected_head_sha or successful mutating reports to commit_sha.
Resolve the resulting commit SHA from the canonical apply report and verify the remote target equals it.
Dispatch PR Generated Artifact Refresh on the resulting exact branch head.
Upload dispatcher, apply, and verification-dispatch evidence as JSON and Markdown.
assertions: The dispatcher report contract is mad4b.governed-generated-artifact-refresh-dispatch.v1 with secrets_included=false and consult_job_logs=false.
The dispatcher has no push trigger; issue_comment and workflow_dispatch are the only command entrypoints.
The dispatcher checks out trusted main with persist-credentials=false before invoking the canonical publisher.
The dispatcher has actions:write, contents:read, issues:write, and pull-requests:read, with no contents:write authority.
Passed dispatcher evidence requires dispatch_requested=true; blocked dispatcher evidence requires first_failure.code.
The direct dispatcher publisher accepts only one open same-repository PR whose branch and head equal target_ref and expected_head_sha.
The fallback workflow_run publisher may replay the same bounded section but is not required for first publication.
The tool is registered as mutating under the governed maintenance-tool root.
The apply workflow is workflow_dispatch-only and not pull_request-triggered.
Protected branches are rejected and force push is absent.
Concurrent target-ref movement returns an expected-head mismatch without writing.
The apply report contract is mad4b.governed-generated-artifact-refresh.v1 with secrets_included=false.
The canonical publisher accepts only registered generated paths and consult_job_logs=false.
A blocked apply binds the unchanged expected_head_sha; a successful mutating apply binds the exact generated commit_sha.
The publisher resolves exactly one same-repository open or merged PR from target_ref and the report candidate.
The verification dispatch evidence contract is mad4b.generated-artifact-refresh-verification-dispatch.v1 with the resulting candidate SHA.
A bot-authored generated commit is followed by an explicit read-only workflow_dispatch on that exact head.
Job logs remain diagnostic-only.

phases.objective: Publish the same exact-head read-only generated-artifact authority for the governed main-to-Production promotion while keeping every mutating path forbidden on protected branches.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository pull request whose head is the repository default branch and whose base is Production
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The Production promotion receives a canonical exact-head generated-artifact report without granting repository write authority or weakening the governed writer boundary.
steps: Classify the event as pull_request rather than workflow_dispatch.
Require a same-repository pull request with the head equal to the repository default branch and the base equal to Production.
Resolve the exact default-branch head SHA and verify both local checkout and remote branch identity.
Run publisher safety tests and governed-writer safety tests before artifact evaluation.
Generate and verify the bounded artifact set only inside the ephemeral runner workspace.
Upload mad4b.pr-generated-artifact-refresh-summary.v1 and publish it through the trusted workflow_run publisher.
Keep workflow_dispatch and every mutating path restricted to non-protected governed work branches.
assertions: The protected promotion exception applies only to the pull_request path main-to-Production.
workflow_dispatch continues to reject main and Production.
Governed Generated Artifact Refresh remains workflow_dispatch-only and rejects both protected branches.
The read-only workflow has contents:read, persist-credentials:false, and no git push.
The canonical report candidate_kind remains head and candidate_sha equals source_head_sha.
The report declares repository_mutation_performed=false and secrets_included=false.
A stale or substituted default-branch head is rejected before publication.

phases.objective: Exercise artifact-download failure, stale protected-head races, malformed reports, publisher retries, dispatch rejection, and generated write-set violations without consulting Job logs for the decision.
Observe the first exact main-to-Production canonical generated-artifact evaluation and verify the writer remains unavailable to protected branches.
Require exact generated-artifact canonical evidence for every protected-branch promotion while retaining manual governed mutation only on non-protected work branches.
